narration: A quiet night on Earth. Somewhere up there is the brightest black hole we know.
As far away as the Andromeda Galaxy, it is already the brightest star in the sky.
note: The distance to the Andromeda Galaxy

narration: At ten thousand light-years, the night is not night any more.
At a hundred and eighty-seven, it shines like our Sun.
Closer still, and the disc itself appears.
The disc swallows half the sky.
